# Chato's Auto Transport & RV Towing

> Owner-operated RV towing, RV transport and car transport based in Escondido, California, serving all of San Diego County, Southern California, Nevada and Arizona. Owner and driver: Jose Barba, 30 years of experience. Phone and text: (760) 532-1964. Hablamos español. Fair quote guaranteed.

Key facts:
- Services: RV towing and RV transport (fifth wheels up to 43 ft, travel trailers, toy haulers, goosenecks, park models, tiny homes, motorhomes), car transport, classic and exotic car transport, boats on trailers, golf carts, motorcycles, ATVs and UTVs.
- Equipment: RAM 3500 dually and a car hauler. Up to 3 of a customer's vehicles per trip; more than 3 is a custom quote.
- Area: San Diego County (Escondido, San Marcos, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Temecula and Murrieta, Ramona, El Cajon, Santee, Chula Vista, Imperial Beach and more), long distance to Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, the Bay Area, Las Vegas NV, Yuma and Arizona, and port delivery for RVs and cars shipping to Hawaii.
- Reviews: 5.0 on Google and 5.0 on Yelp (30 Yelp reviews).
- Hours: Sunday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 4 PM.
